=== about
append with key: an item with a known key replaces it where it stands, a new one is added; the same key twice in one patch keeps the last.
=== page
<ul id="users"><li data-id="1">Ana</li><li data-id="2">Bia</li></ul>
=== input
event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #users
data: key data-id
data: elements <li data-id="2">Bia!</li><li data-id="3">Caio</li>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode append
data: selector #users
data: key data-id
data: elements <li data-id="4">Duda</li><li data-id="4">Duda 2</li>

=== dom
<ul id="users"><li data-id="1">Ana</li><li data-id="2">Bia!</li><li data-id="3">Caio</li><li data-id="4">Duda 2</li></ul>
